text: Poland has long **white** plates with the standard European **blue strip** on the left.
NOTE: Newer electric vehicles have green plates.
text_zh: 波蘭擁有長型**白色**車牌，左側帶有標準的歐洲**藍色飾條**。
注意：較新的電動車擁有綠色車牌。

text: Polish bollards have a **red strip** that wraps all the way around the bollard. This strip has a red reflector on the front (sometimes hard to see), and a white reflector on the back. Bollards sometimes have numbers on them.
There is also a thinner, [curved](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wvnHofq3MFz4x8cm8) version of the bollard.

NOTE: The same design can be found in [Zakarpattia Oblast](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.4892755,22.8226335,3a,15y,293.62h,67.76t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sSZfQwOcH5qCjpxAWOGmgIg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) in Ukraine.
text_zh: 波蘭的路樁有一個環繞整個路樁的**紅色飾條**。這個飾條正面有一個紅色反光片（有時很難看清楚），背面則有一個白色反光片。路樁上有時會印有數字。
也有這種較細且[帶有弧度](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wvnHofq3MFz4x8cm8)的路樁版本。
注意：烏克蘭的[外喀爾巴阡州](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.4892755,22.8226335,3a,15y,293.62h,67.76t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sSZfQwOcH5qCjpxAWOGmgIg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)也能找到相同設計的路樁。

text: Poland usually has thin concrete utility poles with see-through holes. They are commonly known as “**holey poles**”. The holes often do not extend all the way to the bottom of the pole.

Sometimes, two poles are [joined together](https://goo.gl/maps/Vx3xtYdZgLvhFV1R7), or put in an [A-frame](https://goo.gl/maps/HwEYE3Fa7oYY7gfZA) shape. You can also find [round concrete poles](https://goo.gl/maps/ebKDEEhg6C8nj3ms5).
NOTE: Hungary and Romania also have holey poles, but these are wider and more bulky. In addition, the holes extend all the way to the bottom.
text_zh: 波蘭通常有帶透光孔的細混凝土電線桿。它們通常被稱為「**洞洞桿**」。這些孔洞通常不會一路延伸到電線桿底部。
有時候，兩根電線桿會[連接在一起](https://goo.gl/maps/Vx3xtYdZgLvhFV1R7)，或是擺成[A字形](https://goo.gl/maps/HwEYE3Fa7oYY7gfZA)。你也可以找到[圓形混凝土電線桿](https://goo.gl/maps/ebKDEEhg6C8nj3ms5)。
注意：匈牙利和羅馬尼亞也有洞洞桿，但它們更寬、更粗壯。此外，它們的孔洞會一路延伸到底部。

text: Poland has all-white road lines. **Double middle lines** are very common and usually a good clue for Poland.
NOTE: Some other European countries, most notably Denmark and Greece, can have double middle lines.
text_zh: 波蘭的道路標線全為白色。**雙中線**非常普遍，通常是判斷波蘭的好線索。
注意：其他一些歐洲國家，最明顯的是丹麥和希臘，也可能有雙中線。

text: Poland has **square (normal B-type) guardrails**, with circular red reflectors.
NOTE: Poland is one of only a very few European countries with this type of guardrail. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/poland/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 波蘭擁有**方形（標準B型）護欄**，並配有圓形紅色反光片。
注意：波蘭是極少數擁有這種護欄的歐洲國家之一。若想完整了解歐洲護欄，請參閱[這張資訊圖表](/images/poland/europeguardrail.png)。

text: Warning signs are triangular and have a **yellow background** and a distinct **thin red border**.
NOTE: In Europe, this combination of a yellow background with a thin red border is unique to Poland.
text_zh: 警告標誌呈三角形，具有**黃色背景**和明顯的**細紅邊**。
注意：在歐洲，黃色背景搭配細紅邊的組合是波蘭特有的。

text: However, prohibitory signs are round and have a **white background** with a thicker red border.
text_zh: 然而，禁制標誌是圓形的，擁有**白色背景**和較粗的紅邊。

text: Poland has a unique **pedestrian sign**. Instead of the usual zebra stripes, it just has a single horizontal line.
NOTE: Austria and Belgium also have horizontal lines, but they use two lines instead of Poland’s single line.
text_zh: 波蘭有一個獨特的**行人穿越道標誌**。它沒有使用常見的斑馬線條紋，而只有一條水平線。
注意：奧地利和比國也有水平線，但牠們使用的是兩條線，而不是波蘭的單一線條。

text: Regular Polish direction signs have a **green background**. These signs use a distinct font, which is a good clue for Poland.
NOTE: Signs on expressways have a blue background.
text_zh: 波蘭的一般方向標誌具有**綠色背景**。這些標誌使用獨特的字體，是判斷波蘭的好線索。
注意：高速公路上的標誌為藍色背景。

text: Poland has two **town entry signs**: a green one with the locality’s name, and a white-and-black one with a stylized urban area.
NOTE: Like direction signs, town entry signs use a distinct font.
text_zh: 波蘭有兩種**城鎮入口標誌**：一種是帶有地名且背景為綠色的標誌，另一種則是帶有風格化城鎮圖示的黑白標誌。
注意：如同方向標誌，城鎮入口標誌也使用獨特的字體。

text: Polish chevrons are **white with red arrows**.
text_zh: 波蘭的轉彎標誌是**白底紅箭頭**。

text: **Polish** is a Slavic language. In contrast to other slavic languages, the Polish alphabet includes:
- Ł with a stroke through it (unique to Polish)
- Ą and Ę with a small hook (also found in Lithuanian)
- Ć, Ń, Ó, Ś, Ź with an acute accent. Of these, Ń is unique to Polish. In addition, the only other language with Ś and Ź is Montenegrin.
- Ż with a small dot (unique to Polish)

Polish is very consonant-heavy, with lots of consonant clusters. Polish does not use V. Instead, it uses W a lot, the only Slavic language to do so. Other unusually common consonants are the Z, K, and C.
text_zh: **波蘭語**是一種斯拉夫語。與其他斯拉夫語相比，波蘭語字母包含：
- 帶有一斜杠的 Ł（波蘭語獨有）
- 帶有小勾的 Ą 和 Ę（立陶宛語中也能找到）
- 帶有尖音符的 Ć, Ń, Ó, Ś, Ź。其中 Ń 是波蘭語獨有。此外，唯一其他包含 Ś 和 Ź 的語言是蒙特內哥羅語。
- 帶有一小點的 Ż（波蘭語獨有）
波蘭語包含大量子音，有許多子音群。波蘭語不使用 V，而是大量使用 W，這是唯一這樣做的斯拉夫語。其他異常常見的子音還有 Z、K 和 C。

text: Poland is generally a **flat country**, with occasional rolling hills. The country is very green, with a lot of agriculture, and some amount of forest cover.
NOTE: Mountains can be found near the southern border.
text_zh: 波蘭大致上是個**平坦的國家**，偶有起伏的丘陵。這個國家非常綠意盎然，有大量的農業活動，並有一定程度的森林覆蓋。
注意：南部邊境附近可以找到山脈。

text: Many roads in Poland are lined by **rows of trees**.
text_zh: 波蘭的許多道路兩旁都有**成排的樹木**。

text: Neatly **tiled sidewalks** are very common in Poland. Tiles are often grey or light red. Occasionally, even roads have tiled pavement. Many different types of tile patterns occur, including [larger square tiles](https://goo.gl/maps/8S5B5uDchRQ47vD36).
text_zh: 整齊的**磁磚人行道**在波蘭非常普遍。磁磚通常是灰色或淺紅色。偶爾連道路都有磁磚鋪面。會出現許多不同類型的磁磚圖案，包括[較大的方形磁磚](https://goo.gl/maps/8S5B5uDchRQ47vD36)。

text: **Polish architecture** is fairly similar to other Central European countries. Buildings usually have plain stone walls covered in [light or pastel stucco](https://goo.gl/maps/SUmW1ejjpN4hKhnp8). Frequent roofing colours are orange or red, black, and brown. Roof tiles and panes often have a tidy, almost [plastic-like look](https://goo.gl/maps/pQF5LJs2cBYABxvS8). Some rural houses have [corrugated sheet roofs](https://goo.gl/maps/1wzWLhAvvy4byjxc8) similar to those often found in the Baltics.
**Detached **[**single family homes**](https://goo.gl/maps/WW1uktU2VdF8LYop6) are common throughout Poland. They sometimes have a [blocky look](https://goo.gl/maps/tGoCqQWJZQRAQ3AGA).

In bigger towns, **apartment buildings** are common. Many date from communist times, and some of them still have a somewhat [austere look](https://goo.gl/maps/r9oZJoMjKwAWkL6Z6). However, many have been renovated and look [nice and well-kept](https://goo.gl/maps/PP5q8ytbJVbCWQKT6).
**Downtown areas** are usually [dense](https://goo.gl/maps/RM9tSBDsDoJXE67h9) and often have historic buildings.
text_zh: **波蘭建築**與其他中歐國家相當類似。建築物通常有覆蓋著[淺色或粉彩色 stucco](https://goo.gl/maps/SUmW1ejjpN4hKhnp8) 的樸素石牆。常見的屋頂顏色為橘色或紅色、黑色以及棕色。屋頂瓦片和嵌板通常有一種整潔、幾乎[塑膠般的外觀](https://goo.gl/maps/pQF5LJs2cBYABxvS8)。有些鄉村房屋有[波浪板屋頂](https://goo.gl/maps/1wzWLhAvvy4byjxc8)，類似於波羅的海國家常見的那種。
**獨棟**[**單戶住宅**](https://goo.gl/maps/WW1uktU2VdF8LYop6)在整個波蘭都很常見。它們有時帶有[方正的外觀](https://goo.gl/maps/tGoCqQWJZQRAQ3AGA)。
在較大的城鎮中，**公寓大樓**很常見。許多建於共產主義時期，其中一些仍然帶有幾分[嚴肅樸素的外觀](https://goo.gl/maps/r9oZJoMjKwAWkL6Z6)。然而，許多已經過翻新，看起來[美觀且維護良好](https://goo.gl/maps/PP5q8ytbJVbCWQKT6)。
**市中心地區**通常很[密集](https://goo.gl/maps/RM9tSBDsDoJXE67h9)，且經常有歷史建築。

text: Poland is one of the most Catholic countries in Europe. You can often find **Christian shrines** on the side of roads. Blue-white and yellow-white [Polish Catholic flags](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Catholic_flags_of_Poland) also sometimes appear.
text_zh: 波蘭是歐洲最天主教的國家之一。你經常可以在路邊找到**基督教神龕**。藍白色和黃白色的[波蘭天主教旗幟](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Catholic_flags_of_Poland)有時也會出現。

text: A black generation 4 Google car can rarely be found in Poland.
NOTE: It can also be found in many other European countries.
text_zh: 在波蘭很少能找到黑色的第 4 代 Google 車。
注意：它也可以在許多其他歐洲國家找到。

text: A white generation 4 Google car can also rarely be found in Poland.
NOTE: It can also be found in other European countries.
text_zh: 在波蘭也很少能找到白色的第 4 代 Google 車。
注意：這也可以在其他歐洲國家找到。

sections.title: Regional and voivodeship-specific clues
sections.title_zh: 區域與省份特有的線索

text: **Regional** **roads** have 3-digit road numbers. These numbers often appear in yellow boxes on direction signs. The first digit is usually region-specific, as there is a high level of geographic clustering of these road numbers.
There is some overlap between numbers near the margins of the regions. Some exceptions also exist.
NOTE: This tip only applies to 3-digit roads. Bigger roads with 2-digit road numbers mostly do not adhere to this geographic pattern.
text_zh: **區域** **道路**擁有 3 位數的道路編號。這些編號經常出現在方向標誌的黃色方框中。第一位數通常具備區域特異性，因為這些道路編號具有高度的地理群聚性。
在區域邊界附近，編號之間會有一些重疊。也存在一些例外情況。
NOTE: 這個小技巧僅適用於 3 位數的道路。擁有 2 位數路號的大型道路大多不遵循此地理規律。

text: Polish landline phone numbers have 9 digits. The first 2 digits are the **area code**. These area codes are distributed in a sensible manner across the country. Even just learning the first digit of the area codes can greatly narrow down the region. You can click on the infographic to enlarge it.
NOTE: Mobile numbers also have 9 digits, but luckily there is no overlap between the first two digits of mobile numbers and landlines.
text_zh: 波蘭的市話電話號碼為 9 位數。前 2 位數是**區碼**。這些區碼在全國各地以合理的方式分佈。只要學會區碼的第一位數，就能大幅縮小範圍。你可以點擊資訊圖表將其放大。
NOTE: 手機號碼也是 9 位數，但幸運的是，手機號碼的前兩位數與市話沒有重疊。

text: When it comes to Polish place names, the **-owo** ending is mostly limited to the northern half of the country, and the **-ów** ending mostly to the southern half. You may also encounter -ino or -yno, mainly in the northwest, and -ew near the centre of the country.
NOTE: A good way to remember this is that Kraków is in the south of Poland, and most other towns ending in -ów are too.
text_zh: 談到波蘭的地名，**-owo** 結尾主要限於該國的北部地區，而 **-ów** 結尾主要限於南部地區。你可能也會遇到 -ino 或 -yno（主要在西北部），以及 -ew（靠近該國中部）。
NOTE: 記住這一點的好方法是：克拉科夫（Kraków）位於波蘭南部，大多數其他以 -ów 結尾的城鎮也是如此。

text: While rare, bilingual signs can be found in the highlighted regions.
- **Kashubian**, found in the north, is another West Slavic Language, featuring a lot of umlauts and accents.
_Wszëtczi lëdze rodzą sã wòlny ë równy w swòji czëstnoce ë swòjich prawach. Mają òni dostóne rozëm ë sëmienié ë nôlégô jima pòstãpòwac wobec drëdzich w dëchù bracënotë._
- **German** is mostly found in the Opole Voivodeship.
- **Lithuanian **can be found around Puńsk, near the Lithuanian border.
- **Belarusian** is found near the Belarusian border.
- **Lemko, **another Cyrillic language, can be found in the southeast.
text_zh: 雖然罕見，但在突顯的地區中可以找到雙語標誌。
- **卡舒比語（Kashubian）**可在北部找到，是另一種西斯拉夫語言，帶有許多變音符號與腔調。
_Wszëtczi lëdze rodzą sã wòlny ë równy w swòji czëstnoce ë swòjich prawach. Mają òni dostóne rozëm ë sëmienié ë nôlégô jima pòstãpòwac wobec drëdzich w dëchù bracënotë._
- **德語**主要分佈在奧波萊省（Opole Voivodeship）。
- **立陶宛語**可以在立陶宛邊境附近的普恩斯克（Puńsk）周邊找到。
- **白俄羅斯語**可以在白俄羅斯邊境附近找到。
- **萊姆基語（Lemko）**是另一種西里爾字母語言，可在東南部找到。

text: Even though most of Poland is flat, the southern border area is **very hilly**. Some parts even have mountains.
NOTE: Some other areas in Poland are somewhat hilly, but the south has by far the most amount of significant elevation.
text_zh: 儘管波蘭大部分地區是平原，但南部邊境地區**非常丘陵化**。有些地方甚至有山脈。
NOTE: 波蘭的其他一些地區也有點起伏，但南部的顯著高地絕對是最多的。

text: Traditional **wooden houses** are commonly found in the east, mainly in Podlaskie Voivodeship.
text_zh: 傳統**木屋**常見於東部，主要在波德拉謝省（Podlaskie Voivodeship）。

text: **Orchards** are mostly concentrated around the towns of Grójec and Sandomierz in southeastern Poland.
text_zh: **果園**主要集中在波蘭東南部的格魯耶茨（Grójec）和桑多梅日（Sandomierz）城鎮周邊。

text: Electricity poles with **yellow markings** are predominantly found in western and southern Poland.

_For more detailed information on Polish utility poles, including the markings and lamps discussed here, see this [document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1oJxYV55KJpYkST2ZmxXHc9GaNUiOmvyzfXQg_msfvSk/)._
text_zh: 帶有**黃色標記**的電線桿主要分佈在波蘭西部和南部。
_有關波蘭電線桿的更多詳細資訊，包括此處討論的標記和燈具，請參閱此[文件](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1oJxYV55KJpYkST2ZmxXHc9GaNUiOmvyzfXQg_msfvSk/)。_

text: **Black pole markings** are most commonly seen in the southeast of the country, as well as some areas in the north.
text_zh: **黑色電線桿標記**最常見於該國東南部，以及北部的一些地區。

text: Markings with a **white background** are most commonly found in Podlaskie voivodeship, and can occasionally be seen in Łódź voivodeship and elsewhere.
text_zh: 帶有**白色背景**的標記最常見於波德拉謝省，偶爾也會在羅茲省（Łódź voivodeship）及其他地方看到。

text: Street lamps mounted **on top** of the pole become more common towards the northeast of the country, with some pockets in the far south.
text_zh: 安裝在電線桿**頂部**的路燈在該國東北部變得更為常見，極南部也有一些零星分佈。

text: In contrast, lamps attached to the **side** of the pole are rarely found in the northeast.
text_zh: 相比之下，安裝在電線桿**側面**的路燈在東北部很少見。

text: The **Tatra Mountains** are the highest mountains in Poland. They can be found near Zakopane, on the border with Slovakia.
text_zh: **塔特拉山脈（Tatra Mountains）**是波蘭最高的山脈。它們可以在扎科帕內（Zakopane）附近、靠近斯洛伐克的邊境找到。

text: **Gdańsk** is a large city in northwestern Poland. Its historic downtown features unique buildings that were inspired by Dutch Golden Age architecture. These buildings look somewhat similar to Amsterdam.
text_zh: **格但斯克（Gdańsk）**是波蘭西北部的一座大城。其歷史悠久的市中心擁有獨特的建築，靈感來自荷蘭黃金時代的建築。這些建築看起來有點像阿姆斯特丹。

text: The main road on the **Hel peninsula** is very recognizable: it is a coastal forest road with a railway track running parallel to it.
text_zh: **海爾半島（Hel peninsula）**上的主要道路非常容易辨認：這是一條沿海的森林公路，旁邊有一條與其平行的鐵路線。

text: Białystok uses **turquoise** street signs, with the district marked on the bottom.
text_zh: 比亚韦斯托克（Białystok）使用**土耳其玉色**的路標，底部標示著行政區。

text: Szczecin uses colourful **green** and **blue** signs. The city district is marked on the bottom.
text_zh: 什切青（Szczecin）使用色彩繽紛的**綠色**和**藍色**標誌。底部標示著城市行政區。

text: Street signs in Poznań are mainly **black**, with the district being marked on the blue section at the bottom.
text_zh: 波茲南（Poznań）的路標主要是**黑色**的，行政區標示在底部的藍色區塊上。
